CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Last_Audit_Assessment_Date__c), NULL, IF( ISPICKVAL(Audit_Assessment_Frequency__c, "6 mois"), ADDMONTHS(Last_Audit_Assessment_Date__c, 3), IF( ISPICKVAL(Audit_Assessment_Frequency__c, "12 mois"), ADDMONTHS(Last_Audit_Assessment_Date__c, 6), IF( ISPICKVAL(Audit_Assessment_Frequency__c, "24 mois"), ADDMONTHS(Last_Audit_Assessment_Date__c, 12), IF( ISPICKVAL(Audit_Assessment_Frequency__c, "36 mois"), ADDMONTHS(Last_Audit_Assessment_Date__c, 24), NULL ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Next Audit / Assessment Due Date
